metadata.title: Daau Jwng Aloo Jwng Wngkhree | Bodo recipe
metadata.description:
The Bodo community of the Northeast India are one of the most largest indigenous community of Northeast with some pretty amazing cuisine. 

This is a dish made of chicken and Potatoes is perfect for any  time of the day or any season and goes perfectly well with steamed rice or even rotis.
